caption: A glowing bulb is unscrewed from a table lamp, and it goes dark as it comes loose.

sa.check: A table lamp with its bulb glowing.
The bulb is unscrewed from the socket.
The bulb goes dark as it comes loose.
The bulb is turned in the socket before it comes out.
The order is glowing, turning, dark, out.

pc.expect: The bulb goes dark at the moment it comes loose in the socket, and only then; the lamp's own switch is not touched.
pc.fail: The bulb is fully out of the socket and still glowing; or the bulb goes dark before it has been turned; or the bulb goes dark with the hand not yet on it; or the bulb relights once out.

pc.expect: Once dark, the bulb stays dark while it is out of the socket.
pc.fail: The bulb glows in the hand away from the lamp; or flickers on and off as it is withdrawn; or the socket glows after the bulb is out.

pc.expect: The light the lamp cast disappears with the bulb: the shade darkens and the surfaces it lit go dimmer.
pc.fail: The bulb is dark while its light on the table and wall stays; or the shade keeps glowing with the bulb out; or the room brightens as the bulb goes dark.

pc.expect: The bulb turns about its axis in the socket and rises out of it along that axis; the lamp stays put.
pc.fail: The bulb comes straight out without turning; or slides sideways out of the socket; or the lamp turns with the bulb; or the lamp lifts off the table.

pc.expect: One bulb leaves one socket whole; the bulb, socket and shade keep their shapes; fingers pass through nothing.
pc.fail: The bulb passes through the shade or the lamp's body; or a second bulb appears in the socket; or the bulb changes shape or splits; or fingers pass through the bulb.

pc.expect: The shade's colour, the lamp's base and the table stay the same apart from the light.
pc.fail: The shade changes colour rather than brightness; or the base changes shape; or the table's contents rearrange.
